notes.title: Post NEXT FEST Demo update
notes.content:
Here's a Quick Look at the Fixes:


Most Important Changes.
You can FINALLY save the game manually! This was the #1 request. You can now save from the menu whenever you want. 

The Woodcutter Rune quest is fixed. Yeah, that one was on us! It was confusing due to a translation and a tricky objective. We've added a whole new tutorial quest to make it crystal clear. 

Smoothed out music transitions, and balanced the audio. Added missing voice overs. 

Player could get stuck inside stones resource site after talking with worker that is mining it. 

Workers are more responsive to player actions and beave more reliable. 

Reworked key bindings menu. (Still working on polishing it, but it should be much better experience now) 

First time starting the game, it took some time to prepare all assets and to display world in the menu background. Now laoding screen should stay until everything is prepared, so You know when game is prepared to be enjoyed. 

Added more tutorials in different parts of the game.   


Animations. 
Workers will prefer to chop wood than air. 

Workers correctly rotate to proper direction when working/chopping wood etc.  

Some birds could be seen frozen in animation while flying. 

New animation for fishing,  


Settings.
Added an option to disable Lens Flare.  

You can now choose your AA method: TSR, TAA, FXAA or turn it off entirely 

You can also disable the typewriter effect for dialogue. 

 
Game Balance.
Lachea now work much faster. 

Adjusted pricing of some buildings, 


Combat.
When player dodges just after enemy projectile appears, it will cancel homing of the projectile correctly. 

 
UI Fixes.
Adjusted sizes of many fonts and UI elements. 

We've also fixed the annoying bug where the building management window would disappear when mouse cursor is moved out of it. 

Skipping dialogues in cutscenes now shows entire dialogue text on first click, and then skips to next dialgoue phrase after that. 

Tooltips no longer interfere with player when using UI. 

Added info about used and remaining capacity of inventory in buildings. 

Default Language Fix. The game will no longer trap you in Polish if it doesn't support your system language. It will correctly default to English. 

Portugesse translation files was corrupted and messed up the translation. We fixed it. 

Japanesse translation had some formatting tags displayed as text in few places. Fixed.  

Of course it's not the end of work. 

More fixes and improvements coming in future and we are still listening to any feedback.  

Dzar (Jar) - Lead Dev. On behalf of entire Aitvar Studio team.
